items.html: Also these four corrections, which stand between the two Mazalot, Tikkun 8 and Tikkun 13, they join and are included in the head of AVI, which is the throat, and become Mochin there. And on account of that bounty that then multiplies through their power, the body of AVI and the NHY in them are lengthened. For that third part of the Tifferet of AA, which remained of the two parts of the Tifferet that became the two Daat for AVI, from it is made the part of the body for Aba, including HGT, and the part of the body for Ima, including HGT; and this is the secret of the body. And from the abundance of the bounty, three more were made: NHY for Aba, and NHY for Ima.
